domain_specific_rationale: CP-011 provides an exemplary DDD Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL) pattern between high-level creative direction and proprietary video generator syntax. The 3-layer architecture cleanly separates: (1) Semantic AST containing domain concepts (cinematography, lighting, subject action, camera movement, style parameters) derived from ShotVersion; (2) Engine IR acting as a normalized intermediate representation; and (3) Target Payload mapping to concrete downstream provider syntaxes (ComfyUI graph, Runway Gen-3 JSON, Luma API, etc.). This ensures that core domain entities remain pristine and immune to upstream/downstream AI model syntax turbulence.
capability_impact: Directly preserves and enhances CAP-05 (Prompt Compiler & Dynamic Syntax Mapping), preventing generative engine churn from polluting domain models.
residual_risk: New generative AI modalities or non-standard provider parameters may not map cleanly to standard Engine IR constructs. Mitigated by the extensible directives architecture and JSONB snapshot storage in PromptVersion.ast_snapshot.
